events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Festival of Music & Art took place in Bethel, New York, from August 15 to 18, 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years ago, the Woodstock Music & Art Fair kicked off, becoming a defining moment for a generation. What's your standout memory or track from the festival's incredible lineup?

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away at his Graceland home on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Today marks 49 years since we lost the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91 this year. His music still moves us. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Anniversary of Tupac Shakur's passing
events.blurb: Iconic rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and died six days later on September 13.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 this year. His impact on music and culture remains undeniable. What's the Tupac track that still resonates with you?

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's passing
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away in London on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84 this year. His guitar work changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in the UK on September 26, 1969, and in the US on October 1, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover alone is legendary, but what's your go-to track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Rock icon Chrissie Hynde of The Pretenders turns 75 today! Still sounding incredible. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former Oasis frontman, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our Kid, Liam Gallagher, turns 54 today! What's your top track from the Oasis legend or his solo work?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic solo album 'Imagine' in the US on September 9, 1971, and in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. More than just a song, it's an album that still inspires. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago, Apple changed how we listen to music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global celebration of the James Bond film franchise, marking the release date of the first film, Dr. No, on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Happy Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! We're celebrating 007 and all the iconic theme tunes. Which Bond theme gets your vote for the best?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the life and music of John Lennon. His legacy continues to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us so many laughs. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. Which track from it is still on your playlist?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Remembering Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, who passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Today marks 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year. His voice and stage presence remain legendary. What's your favourite Queen anthem?
